invite.v2Subtitle: Earn 2 Coins when an invited player becomes genuinely active, plus 40 Coins if that player later buys Premium or their first Coin package.
invite.v2LinkDescription: Share your personal link. The referral is attached when your friend registers and creates their team.
invite.v2ActivityDescription: The 2-Coin activity reward and 40-Coin paid reward are tracked separately for every referred player.
invite.v2NoActivity: No referrals yet. Share your invite link to start tracking invited players.
invite.v2RejectedDescription: This referral is no longer eligible for rewards.
invite.v2PaidCompletedDescription: Paid conversion completed via {{type}}. The one-time 40-Coin reward was granted.
invite.v2ActivityCompletedDescription: The player recorded activity on 3 separate real days. The 2-Coin activity reward was granted.
invite.v2CappedDescription: The player qualified as active, but the monthly free activity reward limit had already been reached.
invite.v2PendingDescription: The player has recorded {{count}} of the 3 separate active days required for the small activity reward.
invite.v2Step1: Copy or share your personal invite link.
invite.v2Step2: Your friend opens the link, verifies their account, signs up, and creates a real team.
invite.v2Step3: After activity on 3 separate real days, you receive 2 Coins.
invite.v2Step4: If that same referred player later makes their first Premium purchase or first Coin-package purchase, you receive one additional 40-Coin reward. Premium + Coins still count only once for this paid reward.
invite.v2AntiAbuseNote: Self-referrals, deleted/ownerless teams and duplicate referred users do not qualify. Activity is counted by distinct UTC calendar days and the free reward is monthly capped.
